advisor_identified: Guy Frégault, historian of New France at Université de Montréal, then chair of history at the University of Ottawa, 1959–1961.

doctorate.title: La carrière de Pierre Le Moyne d'Iberville

evidence.says: Québec's cultural heritage register states that Frégault received his doctorate in history at Loyola University in Chicago in 1942, with a thesis on Pierre Le Moyne d'Iberville et d'Ardillères. It also identifies his appointment as head of history at Ottawa in 1959.

Université de Montréal's archives independently confirm a doctorate in history from Loyola in Chicago for a thesis on Pierre Le Moyne d'Iberville, followed by teaching at Montréal and a period at Ottawa.

The Canadian Historical Association's author note in Canadian Society in the French Regime identifies Guy Frégault as chair of the University of Ottawa history department from 1959 to 1961 and records his studies at Montréal and Loyola in Chicago.
Lionel Groulx, Mes mémoires, tome IV, p. 171, names Frégault's thesis subject as La carrière de Pierre Le Moyne d'Iberville and states that he returned from Loyola with a doctorate in history.

notes: AHA record 22631 matches the advisor's institution, year and thesis subject. The title above follows Groulx's wording; the exact submitted title, including the linked record's additional 'Sieur', was not independently verified in a thesis catalogue.
